jobs.occupation: Student assistant interested in turning data and insights into actions
jobs.description:
Student assistant interested in turning data and insights into actions

Posted:  10/28/26

Office Location(s):  Klausdalsbrovej 601, Ballerup, Denmark

Would you like to help strengthen climate adaptation across the Nordic region? Join Tryg’s Climate Excellence team as a student assistant and help turn data into insights that support better decisions.

About the job | A student job that creates value

You will join the newly established Climate Excellence team, part of Tryg’s Insurance Technical Group Function. The function drives technical excellence and data-driven decision-making across the Nordic business to support Tryg’s long-term competitiveness.

The goal of Climate Excellence is to help Tryg better understand and respond to climate risks, supporting smarter decisions for both the business and our customers.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Collecting, structuring, and visualizing data and information for analysis

• Exploring trends across multiple data sources and translating findings into practical recommendations

• Preparing presentations and decision-support material for colleagues and management

• Supporting projects and initiatives related to climate adaptation and resilience

You will gain insight into how data, insurance, climate adaptation, and business strategy come together in practice while developing analytical and communication skills in a Nordic organization.

The role is based in Ballerup and involves collaboration with colleagues in Denmark, Sweden, and Norway. We occasionally meet as a Nordic team in Bergen or Stockholm, approximately once a month. Participation is optional, and online attendance is always possible.

About you | Curious, collaborative, and interested in working with data

You are currently enrolled in a relevant higher education programme, such as business, economics, engineering, technology, mathematics, data science, climate studies, or a related field. Ideally, you have at least two years remaining in your studies.

You enjoy working with both quantitative and qualitative information, identifying patterns, and presenting insights in a clear and structured way. You are curious about developments in society and motivated by learning through varied tasks and collaborations.

The following skills will help you succeed in the role:

• Experience using Excel to structure and analyze data

• Experience using PowerPoint to communicate insights and recommendations

• An interest in data analysis and tools such as Python

• Strong written and spoken English skills

You do not need to meet every criterion to apply. We are primarily looking for someone with curiosity, motivation, and the willingness to learn. Danish language skills are an advantage but not a requirement.

The position is approximately 15 hours per week, and your working hours will be planned flexibly around your studies and exam periods.

About us | Personal and professional development

Climate Excellence works across Tryg’s Nordic business to develop and standardize climate-related initiatives and strengthen climate knowledge throughout the organization.

You will join a small Nordic team with backgrounds in climate, analytics, insurance, and business development. We collaborate closely across countries and functions and believe the best solutions are created through teamwork, knowledge sharing, and diverse perspectives.

We offer:

• Meaningful tasks with real business impact

• A supportive environment with responsibility and guidance

• Flexible working arrangements that accommodate your studies

• Opportunities for personal and professional development

• A strong professional and social community

We look forward to hearing from you

We welcome applications from students of all backgrounds and value different perspectives. We focus on skills, motivation, and potential, and strive to provide an inclusive recruitment process and working environment. We encourage you not to attach a photo to your CV.

We recommend sending the application as soon as possible as we are holding interviews continuously.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Business Analyst Oliver Christensen at: oliver.c@tryg.dk

Application deadline: 15 November 2026.

Imagine a future where you are a key part of our Asset Integrity Team operating some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets both onshore and offshore

Welcome to Asset Integrity

You’ll be part of Asset Integrity where you, together with your engineering colleague will support the organisation with your mechanical engineering skills in the operation, inspection, engineering, integrity and asset management. As a team we foster collaboration and innovation. We are a group of ambitious professionals within different engineering disciplines, who are passionate and motivated and who value teamwork as an essential part of safeguarding our assets.

You’ll play an important role in:

• executing various engineering studies and tasks for onshore oil&gas terminals and offshore and onshore pipelines both internally and by defining scope of work and liaison with external engineering consultants

• performing inspection data analysis and integrity assessment of our approx 800km of pipelines

• supporting the  offshore inspection and maintenance campaigns.

• liaison with Authorities, Contractors, Oil&Gas companies and other third parties.

• act as offshore company representative/supervisor onboard contractors’ vessels

• ensure and perform engineering and quality check and final delivery of inspection results to our Integrity engineers

• providing input to budgets and reporting to management.

Once familiar with our systems, you will be included in a 24/7 duty roster to respond to emergency situations.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have key focus on safety, which shall be embedded in all the work you do;

• hold an engineering degree, preferably in mechanical engineering

• have experience working with oil&gas plant and pipeline integrity and engineering both onshore and  offshore

• have experience working with engineering companies, contractors and/or suppliers;

• have experience working with practical onshore and offshore pipeline operation and maintenance as well as experience in marine and subsea operations and inspection methods

• have a proactive and systematic approach to your work tasks

• possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can work independently in your area of responsibility and participate in a culture of knowledge sharing in an open, honest and  trustful culture

• are a team player who thrives on solving complex problems together with your colleagues.

• speak and write English fluently and knowledge with a Scandinavian language is an advantage.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. You’ll receive the training needed to maintain and further develop your competencies.

The role involves some travel, including two to three day trips per month to onshore sites, a two-week offshore campaign in summer, and a few conferences or courses each year.

Working at Ørsted

In the Asset Integrity department we have the responsibility for looking after some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets. We have highly skilled employees dedicated to safeguard and care for our assets.

We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and diverse workplace with constructive feedback and continuous learning, enabling our people to develop their expertise in asset integrity and engineering.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

Position salary range:

For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr68,100.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

Our benefits package:

For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

Pre-employment background check:

This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Digital Servicebook is a Danish automotive tech and SaaS company, founded in 2015. We make car service history digital, accessible and aggregated across car brands and connect independent workshops, car manufacturers' digital service registers and other players in the automotive industry.

Our platform is supported globally and is widely used in Europe. We have sales offices in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, the UK and the Netherlands, are continuously working to expand our presence in more markets and collaborate with some of the biggest players in the industry.

We work purposefully with AI and new technologies that make everyday life easier and our processes more efficient. We are a small, dynamic organization in growth, and now our finance function must keep up.

About the position

You will be responsible for the entire day-to-day finance function – from vouchers and reconciliations to monthly reporting, budgets and forecasts. It is a hands-on role: you do the bookkeeping yourself, and you are also the one who gives the management and the board a true and timely picture of the finances.

You will work closely with the COO and management, and you will have a real influence on how we structure processes, systems and reporting as we grow.

Your primary tasks

• Ongoing bookkeeping, voucher management and reconciliation of bank, debtors, creditors and intermediate accounts

• Invoicing and customer follow-up across subscriptions, transaction-based services and payment flows (e.g. e-conomic and Stripe)

• Reconciliation between CRM, payment platform and accounting, so we know that all customers are invoiced correctly

• Month, quarterly and year-end closing as well as collaboration with the auditor

• VAT and duties, including VAT on sales abroad

• Coordination of payroll and payroll-related tasks, also for employees in other countries

• Controlling and monthly management and board reporting (profit, balance sheet and key figures)

• Preparation and follow-up on budget and ongoing forecast, including cash management

• Finances across companies and countries in the group

• Continuous improvement and automation of financial processes and systems

Your profile

• You have solid experience with independent bookkeeping and closing of accounts – preferably 5+ years

• You have experience with controlling, budgeting and forecasting and can translate numbers into clear recommendations

• Relevant education, accountant background or equivalent experience

• You are strong in Excel and have experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

• You are good at Danish and English in writing and speech

• It is an advantage if you have experience with SaaS/subscription finance, foreign companies or VAT across countries

• You are structured, accurate and self-driven – and you thrive on having both your hands in the bookkeeping and the overview of the whole

We offer

• A central role with great independence and direct influence in a growing company

• Short path to decisions and close cooperation with management

• An international industry in digital transformation

• Salary, according to qualifications,

• Working hours / flexibility

Apply →

The Impact You'll Make

Are you interested in innovation, technology scouting, AI tools, and digital transformation? The CF-MAI Technology Management & Innovation team is looking for a student worker to support a range of innovation and technology projects while gaining hands-on experience in a global technology organization.

What You’ll Be Doing

• 
Support technology and company research, reporting, and analysis

• 
Learn and utilize Danfoss' technology scouting platform to support technology intelligence activities

• 
Support the design and development of AI assistants using Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio to improve productivity and user experiences

• 
Assist innovation and technology projects with coordination and execution activities

• 
Create presentations, communication materials, and training content, support data collection and reporting, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive innovation and technology initiatives forward.

What We're Looking For

We imagine you are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree within Engineering Innovation and Business, Software Engineering, Supply Chain Digitalization, Mechatronics Engineering or a related field.

Besides your degree, we are looking for someone who:

• Is comfortable using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot or OpenAI tools, and has some experience building AI agents or assistants

• Has strong analytical and data-handling skills

• Is proficient in Excel and PowerPoint or can learn quickly

• Has experience supporting projects and developing presentations

• Is proactive, structured, and eager to learn, and can communicate effectively in English

The following are considered advantages:

• Power BI experience

• Python knowledge

• AI-assisted coding experience

What You'll Get from Us

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• Minimum 8 hours per week, and flexibility around your studies and exams.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

Our Commitment to Transparency

Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our FAQ Page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Brand

Danfoss engineers solutions that increase machine productivity, reduce emissions, lower energy consumption, and enable electrification.

Our solutions are used in areas such as refrigeration, air conditioning, heating, power conversion, motor control, industrial machinery, marine, and on- and off-highway equipment. We also provide solutions for data centers, renewable energy, energy storage, heat recovery, as well as contribute to district energy solutions for cities.

Our innovative engineering dates back to 1933. Danfoss is family-owned and employs over 39,000 people. We create long-term value for our customers in more than 100 countries with a global footprint of around 100 factories.

**A Snapshot of Your Day

**For our Product Cybersecurity department, we are looking for an experienced, highly skilled and motivated Product Cybersecurity Architect to drive the definition and implementation of solution-wide security across exciting industrial product ranges. In this role, you will provide cybersecurity architecture expertise across multiple product and engineering domains, contribute to the development of cybersecurity standards and architectural principles, and work closely with development teams to strengthen the security and resilience of our products and solutions.

You will be part of Product Cybersecurity department, an international team of cybersecurity professionals united by a shared mission: enabling secure digitalization and ensuring that cybersecurity is built into products and solutions by design.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**

• Define and maintain overall cybersecurity architectural framework for products and solutions

• Establish and maintain cybersecurity principles, standards, guardrails, reference architectures, and secure development practices aligned with industry standards.

• Translate business, regulatory, and customer requirements into secure and scalable architectural solutions.

• Drive the adoption of Secure-by-Design principles and practices across products, solutions, and engineering processes.

• Facilitate cybersecurity architecture and design reviews, ensuring alignment with secure-by-design principles and organizational security objectives.

• Provide cybersecurity guidance on design and implementation to product development teams.

• Perform threat modeling and risk assessments at component, system, and solution levels.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to integrate cybersecurity requirements into product roadmaps, development processes, and engineering practices.

• Provide cybersecurity expertise and advisory support throughout customer projects, from proposal and design phases through implementation and delivery.

• Support cybersecurity certification, compliance, and assessment activities, including alignment with ISA/IEC 62443, Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2, and other applicable requirements.

**What You Bring

**

• An academic degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable field.

• Several years of experience in cybersecurity, product security, or OT cybersecurity in an architect, lead specialist, or similar role.

• Excellent technical security knowledge based on cybersecurity standards and good practices.

• Experience with widely recognized OT cybersecurity standards, including ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and ISO 27001.

• Experience with threat modeling, risk assessment, and security architecture reviews.

• Experience with SCADA systems, Industrial Control Systems (ICS), and industrial communication networks.

• Knowledge of containerization and container orchestration security.

• Knowledge of cloud security principles and architecture.

• Understanding of AI-driven cybersecurity, including the use of AI in both offensive and defensive security contexts, and its implications for product security, threat detection, and secure system architecture.

• Fluency in English. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate technical information to non-technical stakeholders

• Proven ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

You are an ideal candidate, if you have:

• Relevant cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, CCSP, or ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Expert.

• Knowledge of security and enterprise architecture frameworks such as SABSA and TOGAF.

• Experience with regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to OT and connected products, including NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and NERC CIP.

• Experience with software supply chain security, SBOM governance, and vulnerability management processes.

**About The Team

**Digital Products and Solutions (DPS) serves as Siemens Energy’s in-house digital product delivery partner and a global center of excellence for software engineering. Our mission is to develop standardized, high-quality, and scalable software products and services that strengthen the company’s digital foundation and create significant value for both internal and external customers.

By accelerating the delivery of new software engineering products and services, we help reduce time to market and contribute directly to Siemens Energy’s business success.

As part of the Product Cybersecurity team, you will play a key role in embedding cybersecurity into the design, development, and delivery of Siemens Energy's products and solutions, helping ensure they remain secure, resilient, and compliant in an evolving threat landscape. The team works closely with product owners, architects, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to define security principles, provide practical guidance, and support the implementation of scalable security solutions across the product lifecycle.Who is Siemens Energy?

**Who is Siemens Energy?

**At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

**Our Commitment to Diversity

**Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

**Rewards/Benefits

**

• In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme

• We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder

• We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity

• The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose

• In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

Are you passionate about building business-critical trading software where every microsecond counts? Do you thrive in an environment that values code quality and collaboration with talented peers? If so, Alipes Capital could be the perfect place for you.

About the Role

At Alipes, you will be part of a team developing in-house financial software in C#, where you will:

• 
Implement, verify and optimize financial algorithms

• 
Create infrastructure to support analysis of new algorithms and execution of the existing ones

• 
Improve automated monitoring of the algorithms

In doing so you will get a chance to tackle a variety of performance problems, such as GC, networking and parallelization, ensuring that we are trading leaders in the market.

You will get instant validation of your work and experience short feedback cycles, where going from inception to deployment can be a matter of hours. There will be no red tape to cut and no sales people to consult.

About the Team

We’re a growing team of 25 software engineers who are passionate about what we do. You’ll be working in an informal environment where technical discussions are valued, and you’re encouraged to take ownership and pride in your work. You’ll have real influence on the team’s direction, set your own priorities, and choose the tools that get the job done.

We work closely with our quantitative analysts and traders, collaborating daily to bridge the gap between research and production. This cross-functional setup means you’ll have direct access to the people designing the models, allowing for rapid feedback, shared problem-solving, and a deeper understanding of the business logic behind the code.

About You

• 
At least 3 years of experience with C#

• 
Working knowledge of (T-)SQL

• 
A good understanding of algorithms and data structures and when to apply them

• 
A scientific and inquisitive mind

Nice to have

• 
Experience working with low latency systems

• 
Proficiency in languages like C, C++, Python or Matlab

• 
Knowledge of SQL Server tuning and administration

• 
PhD or MSc in Computer Science or equivalent

What we can Offer You

• 
Competitive benefits, including pension, health insurance, and 30 days of vacation.

• 
A modern, harbour front office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn) with a flexible hybrid work model.

• 
A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.

• 
A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.

• 
Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.

• 
Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.

Practicalities

Interviews will take place in Week 47 and 48.

If it was less than 4 years since you finished university, please attach your university transcripts to your application.

Should you have any questions regarding the job, you are welcome to reach out to us at tech_jobs@alipescapital.com. Please do not send your application to the email address, as our hiring team will not have visibility. We look forward to reviewing your application!

Deadline

November 8th, 2026

Do you have experience configuring, testing and commissioning control systems for high-voltage substations? Would you like to apply your expertise to projects supporting Denmark’s electricity transmission grid? Join COWI as a Substation Control and Automation Specialist.

Develop and commission substation control systems

We are looking for an experienced specialist to work on control and automation systems for Energinet’s 132–400 kV substations. Projects range from new substations to extensions, refurbishment and replacement of systems at existing sites.

You will design, configure, test and commission substation control systems, including remote terminal units (RTUs), bay control units (BCUs) and human–machine interfaces (HMIs). Working closely with other specialists, you will ensure that these systems operate correctly and integrate with the substation’s primary equipment, protection systems and communication infrastructure.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Design and configure substation control and monitoring functions in accordance with functional requirements and customer specifications.

• Configure, test and commission RTUs, bay control units and HMIs.

• Configure and verify communication interfaces between control devices, protection equipment and remote control systems.

• Plan and perform functional and integration testing to verify control functions, signal exchange and correct operation of system interfaces.

• Troubleshoot configuration, communication and interface issues in collaboration with other technical specialists.

• Prepare and maintain configuration documentation, test procedures and test records.

• Coordinate technical interfaces with colleagues responsible for protection, communication systems, electrical design and primary equipment

• Undertake the designated on-site role of “holdleder” when required and subject to the relevant qualifications and authorisation.

Your expertise

You take a systematic approach to configuration, testing and troubleshooting. You work independently, pay close attention to technical detail and collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers and suppliers. You understand how individual devices and interfaces contribute to the operation of the complete substation control system.

You will also bring:

• A relevant qualification in electrical engineering or an equivalent technical background, combined with at least five years of relevant experience with control systems for high-voltage substations.

• Demonstrated experience configuring and testing substation control equipment from multiple manufacturers.

• Practical experience with IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 60870-5-103 and IEC 61850 communication protocols and standards.

• A sound understanding of the interfaces between substation control systems, protection equipment and high-voltage primary equipment.

• Experience with functional testing, system integration and commissioning of substation control systems.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• The ability to obtain the required security clearance and meet the qualification and authorisation requirements for acting as “holdleder” at high-voltage substations.

Your place of work

Depending on project requirements, you may work from one of COWI’s offices in Denmark, at Energinet project locations or partly from home. Testing and commissioning activities will require attendance at the relevant project sites. Travel within Denmark is expected.

A place to work and so much more

At COW, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Head of Discipline Carsten Sass Husum at CSHU@COWI.COM.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Equal opportunity employer

COWI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, COWI complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.description:
The National Museum’s Conservation and Restoration unit is seeking a conservator for a 2-year project, focusing on recent wood conservation within the museum, with a focus on church furnishings and furniture.

Work areas

You will be part of a team of conservators with many specialties. Your main responsibility will be the conservation and documentation of wooden objects, furniture, and interiors, as well as the dismantling and assembly of interiors in historic buildings and churches. The tasks also include preventive conservation. The work is part of the unit’s revenue-generating business.

In addition, there may be tasks within the National Museum’s own exhibitions, involving work with installations, exhibition care, and possibly in our magazines.

Qualifications

We expect you to have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in conservation from a recognized educational institution or equivalent. In addition, we will emphasize that you have the following:

• Practical experience with the conservation of wooden objects or knowledge of traditional craft techniques within carpentry or furniture making

• Experience with the conservation of cultural and historical objects that are still in use. Specific experience with church furnishings is desirable, but not a requirement

• Experience with pest control, treatment of fungally infected wood and stabilization of decayed wood, including the conservation of wooden objects exhibited outdoors

• Experience with budgeting and time management

• Good teamwork skills

• Driving license (B)

Wage and employment conditions

The average working hours are 37 hours per week. We have flexible hours. Wage and employment conditions are determined according to the current collective agreement for academics in the State or the organizational agreement for technical employees.

The workplace is Brede north of Copenhagen. There will be business trips of shorter or longer periods in relation to specific projects.

The National Museum must have the opportunity to assess a criminal record for private use prior to employment.

The position is to be filled with effect from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is limited in time to 2 years.

Application

The National Museum’s ambition is to create a workplace where diversity is not only tolerated, but actively promoted and valued. We therefore encourage all qualified individuals, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

We are actively working to reduce bias in the recruitment process to ensure a diverse workforce and to ensure that we hire the most suitable candidates based on professional and personal qualifications. We therefore ask that you refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

Written applications (in Danish or English) with information about education and previous employment should be sent via our electronic recruitment system on the National Museum’s website and must reach the museum no later than Tuesday, November 24, 2026.

We expect to hold job interviews at the beginning of week 49.

For further information regarding the position, please contact conservator Kim Alberdi at +45 41 20 65 94, kim.alberdi@natmus.dk or unit manager Eva Bøje Nielsen at + 45 41 20 65 70, eva.boje.nielsen@natmus.dk

Are you passionate about clinical trials and want to be involved in designing them? Do you have experience monitoring studies and analyzing data?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Senior Clinical Scientist Director, Clinical Development, Endocrine & Rare Diseases

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking an energetic and passionate Senior Clinical Scientist to join our team. As a member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in designing, monitoring and analyzing clinical trials within the Endocrine and Rare Disease Medical Sciences area. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will join the Clinical Development team, being part of the Endocrine & Rare Disease Medical Sciences organization. You will report to the VP of Clinical Science who is based in the US. You will be based in Hellerup together with the Danish team.

Since you will join a team based in different time zones, you must be available for evening meetings. This position may also require occasional international travel.

Your key responsibilities will be

• For clinical trials: design, provide oversight, and support site and subject retention

• Ensure successful completion of documents (including clinical trial protocols, investigator brochures, monitoring plans, site training materials, clinical study reports, health authority responses, standard operating procedures, etc.) with cross-functional team members

• Participate in study teams and cross-functional teams as appropriate and as delegated

• Ensure consistent use of language and criteria across multiple endocrine projects

• Ensure study integrity and track accumulating safety and efficacy data

• Anticipate obstacles within a clinical trial and implement solutions

• Analyze, evaluate, and support accurate interpretation and reporting of clinical data

• Contribute to drafting and reviewing clinical documents, manuscripts, presentations, and regulatory submissions

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant science, medical information, good clinical practices, and regulatory guidance

• Collaborate with—and serve as a clinical research resource for—cross-functional colleagues to optimize product development

• Cultivate relationships with investigative sites, clinical consultants, and key opinion leaders to represent the interests of the company

• Complete assigned tasks thoroughly, accurately, and on time

• Adhere to rigorous ethical standards

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant degree, e.g., cand.pharm/Msc in Pharmacy or equivalent. You also have a strong track record of scientific and clinical inquiry.

About Us

nShift is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 460 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

Purpose of role:

nShift has a self-serve product purchase route into delivery management for small and midsize shippers. Customers find us online or through partners, start a trial, connect their shop and carriers, and move to a paid subscription without needing a traditional sales process.

In 2027, we want to turn that route into a measurable growth engine with a clear commercial return.

As Product-Led Growth Marketing Manager, you will own this growth stream end to end: the plan, funnel, budget, vendors and performance. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone with experience who can set the strategy and execute it.

You will inherit an existing product, website, pricing model, onboarding journey, data and lessons from what has already been tried. Your job is to decide what comes next and build a repeatable model for growth.

What you’ll be doing:

• Own the growth plan for self-serve, including target segments, markets, channel mix, budget, and commercial targets.

• Build and maintain the funnel model from website visit through signup, activation, paid conversion and retention, including acquisition cost, payback and conversion at each stage.

• Report on performance, identifying what is working, what needs to change, and where to invest next and act on the findings.

• Grow qualified traffic and trial signups through paid and organic search, ecommerce platform ecosystems, partnerships and other channels that reach small and midsize shippers.

• Set targets for paid media, manage external vendors, and make decisions on spend based on performance.

• Develop partnerships and co-marketing opportunities with ecommerce platforms, agencies, publishers and relevant communities.

• Own the self-serve website footprint as a conversion channel, including site structure, pricing, campaign landing pages, copy, proof and the signup journey.

• Run an ongoing experimentation program across acquisition, website conversion and signup, moving from hypothesis to test to decision.

• Work closely with Product to improve trial activation, onboarding and in-product guidance, and define the usage signals that show when a customer is reaching value.

• Build lifecycle communication from signup through paid conversion and expansion with the marketing automation team.

• Define the product events, properties and reporting needed to understand the funnel, working with Product and other teams to make that data usable across Marketing and Sales.

• Bring customer, market and funnel evidence into pricing and packaging decisions with Product and Finance, and test offers and trial variants against conversion and payback.

About you:

You are comfortable owning a commercial problem where not every answer has already been defined.

You can move between strategy and execution without losing sight of the number you are responsible for. You make decisions from evidence, communicate clearly when something is not working and change course when the data calls for it.

You are also comfortable working across functions. Success in this role depends on Product, Sales, Web, Finance, Support and Customer Success, but you will remain accountable for bringing those pieces together into a working growth model.

What you will bring:

• Five or more years of experience in growth, performance or digital marketing in B2B software, including at least two years working with a self-serve or product-led funnel from trial or freemium to paid.

• Experience marketing to merchants using platforms such as Shopify, WooCommerce or Magento, including app or partner ecosystems.

• Experience owning a growth target and budget, with clear examples of how you used performance data to change the plan.

• Strong understanding of funnel economics, including customer acquisition cost, conversion, retention and payback.

• Hands-on knowledge of GA4, Google Ads and at least one other major paid platform, with enough depth to manage and challenge an external agency or vendor.

• Experience improving websites and landing pages through testing, conversion analysis, and customer evidence. HubSpot CMS experience or equivalent is essential.

• A practical understanding of SEO, including search intent, page planning and content performance.

• Experience with lifecycle marketing and automation, including segmentation and triggered journeys.

• Experience working directly with product teams in areas such as signup, onboarding, in-product communication, pricing, or packaging.

• Strong written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

• Experience in logistics, shipping, ecommerce infrastructure, or delivery software.

• Experience with at least one product analytics platform such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or PostHog, including event definition and cohort analysis

• Experience growing software products in the Nordic markets.

• HubSpot experience or certifications.

• Experience running pricing, packaging, offer or trial experiments.

jobs.description:
Bliv en del af holdet hos Le Petit Vinbar i Torvehallerne

Har du interesse for vin, sans for godt værtskab og lyst til at gøre en forskel? Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Hos Le Petit Vinbar søger vi en eller to ekstraordinære kolleger til et lille, men stærkt internationalt team af engagerede mennesker, der brænder for at skabe oplevelser som gæsterne husker – og vender tilbage til.

Vi tilbyder op til 120 timer om måneden til en person eller ca. 60 timer hver til to personer. Vagterne ligger mellem kl. 9 og 21, både på hverdage og i weekender.

Godt værtskab er kernen i det, vi laver

Vi søger dig, der tager initiativ, har blik for detaljerne og møder mennesker med varme og nysgerrighed. Du lægger mærke til, hvad gæsterne har brug for, og gør dig umage for, at alle føler sig set, velkomne og godt taget hånd om – også når der er travlt.

Du har erfaring fra café, bar eller restaurant og trives med at tage ansvar. Du behøver ikke være faglært tjener eller vinekspert, men du er interesseret i vin og har lyst til at lære og dele din viden med gæsterne. Interesse for mad er også et plus. Du kan kommunikere med vores gæster på dansk eller engelsk.

Vi er et lille hold, hvor alle tager del i hverdagens opgaver: vinservering, gæsteservice, madlavning, opfyldning og oprydning. Vi hjælper hinanden og lægger vægt på både godt samarbejde og omhu i det daglige arbejde.

Om Le Petit Vinbar

Le Petit Vinbar er en lille, livlig vin- og champagnebar midt i Torvehallerne i København. Baren blev grundlagt i 2013 af Ole Mejlby og Sylvain Codron, og vi importerer selv vores vine direkte fra små producenter i Frankrig, Italien og Østrig.

Hos os mødes vininteresse og personligt værtskab. Vi deler gerne historierne bag vinene og hjælper gæsterne med at finde noget, de bliver glade for – uanset om de kommer for et enkelt glas eller en hel eftermiddag.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team med mulighed for at lære mere om vin, mad og service og sætte dit præg på gæsternes oplevelse.

Praktisk information og ansøgning

Løn og tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV til job@lepetitvinbar.dk. Fortæl os gerne, hvorfor du har lyst til at arbejde hos os, om du søger ca. 60 eller op til 120 timer om måneden, og hvornår du kan starte.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette eller de rette kolleger. Send derfor gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Join the team at Le Petit Vinbar in Torvehallerne

Do you have an interest in wine, a flair for hospitality and a desire to make a difference? Then we’d love to hear from you.

At Le Petit Vinbar, we’re looking for one or two extraordinary colleagues to join our small but strong international team of dedicated people who are passionate about creating experiences that guests remember—and return for.

We offer up to 120 hours per month for one person, or approximately 60 hours each for two people. Shifts fall between 9 am and 9 pm, on both weekdays and weekends.

Hospitality is at the heart of everything we do

We’re looking for someone who takes initiative, pays attention to detail and approaches people with warmth and curiosity. You notice what guests need and take care to make everyone feel seen, welcome and well looked after—even when it’s busy.

You have experience working in a café, bar or restaurant and enjoy taking responsibility. You don’t need to be a formally trained waiter or a wine expert, but you have an interest in wine and are keen to learn and share your knowledge with guests. An interest in food is also a plus. You can communicate with our guests in Danish or English.

We’re a small team where everyone contributes to the daily tasks: serving wine, looking after guests, preparing food, restocking and keeping things clean and tidy. We help each other and value teamwork and care in our everyday work.

About Le Petit Vinbar

Le Petit Vinbar is a small, lively wine and champagne bar in the heart of Torvehallerne in Copenhagen. Founded in 2013 by Ole Mejlby and Sylvain Codron, we import our wines directly from small producers in France, Italy and Austria.

Here, a love of wine meets personal hospitality. We enjoy sharing the stories behind our wines and helping guests find something they’ll love—whether they’re stopping by for a single glass or spending the whole afternoon with us.

You’ll join a dedicated team, with opportunities to learn more about wine, food and service, and to make your mark on our guests’ experience.

Salary and start date by agreement.

We review applications and hold interviews on an ongoing basis, and will hire once we’ve found the right person or people. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**

We look forward to hearing from you.

atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, and Sweden.

We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

**Project Scheduler at atNorth

**Are you a master of project controls who thrives on turning complex infrastructure dependencies into highly predictable, synchronized execution plans? As a Project Scheduler at atNorth, you will ensure accurate planning, coordination, and tracking of all activities across the entire data center construction lifecycle. You will act as the critical link connecting our engineering, procurement, and construction teams, ensuring that every milestone from initial design to final commissioning stays firmly on track.

This is a high-impact position within our PMO structure where your analytical insights, critical path analyses, and proactive risk-mapping will directly drive predictable, on-time project delivery across our rapidly expanding Nordic footprint.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Develop, baseline, and maintain fully integrated master schedules for our data center projects, meticulously covering design, permitting, civil works, MEP installation, commissioning, and final handover.

• Ensure procurement timelines for long-lead items (LLI) and owner-furnished, contractor-installed (OFCI) equipment are seamlessly integrated into the active construction schedules.

• Monitor schedule performance using Earned Value Management (EVM) and progress metrics. Identify deviations, track float, and proactively flag critical path risks and delay mitigation opportunities to Project Managers and senior stakeholders.

• Rigorously review and challenge external contractor schedules for logic, realism, and contractual compliance, highlighting gaps or inconsistencies before they impact the site.

• Support weekly and monthly programme reviews by preparing updated schedules, dashboards, look-aheads, and scenario/what-if analyses. Partner with Cost Management to align schedule tracking with cash flow forecasting.

• Refine planning standards, templates, and scheduling methodologies in coordination with the PMO to increase delivery efficiency portfolio-wide.

**Your profile:

**

• A technical degree in Construction Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

• 5+ years of dedicated project controls, scheduling, or planning experience, with a distinct preference for professionals coming out of the data center sector or complex, mission-critical infrastructure environments.

• Advanced, hands-on proficiency in industry-standard planning tools, specifically Primavera P6 and MS Project.

• Deep understanding of data center design and construction workflows, scheduling logic, interdependencies, and Earned Value Management methodology.

• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge external contractors and translate complex timeline risks into clear, actionable advice for internal project teams.

• Holding a PMP or Prince2 certification is considered a strong advantage.

• Fluency in written and spoken English is required; proficiency in any local Nordic language is a plus.

**About the atNorth Culture

**We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together. #99

NN.07 stands for No Nationality, and was founded in 2007. We are dedicated to reimagine timeless designs to create future classics. With the world as our playground and our source of inspiration, we are developing a consistent wardrobe with both simplicity and expressiveness. Marketplace channels are a strategic growth area for us, and we are ready to take our digital presence to the next level. Partnerships like the Zalando Partner Program together with Farfetch, are central to that ambition. The Role We are looking for an ambitious and commercially driven Marketplace Manager to take ownership of growing our marketplace business across existing and future partners. This role is ideal for someone who can combine commercial thinking, marketplace expertise, marketing understanding and strong analytical skills. You will be responsible for driving sales growth, improving visibility and conversion, identifying new opportunities within existing channels, and helping shape the future marketplace strategy for the brand. Responsibilities

• Own and develop the marketplace growth strategy across existing and future channels, with a clear focus on sales performance, profitability, visibility and long-term commercial potential

• Manage and grow key marketplace partnerships, including the Zalando Partner Program and leading the commercial development of Farfetch

• Analyse product and assortment performance to identify opportunities for replenishment, category growth and overall marketplace improvement, while ensuring strong execution across onboarding, content quality, stock availability and platform requirements

• Track, analyse and report on key performance metrics, including sell-through, stock levels, margins, product performance, campaign impact and channel profitability, turning insights into clear business actions

• Drive marketplace marketing opportunities in close collaboration with Marketing and external partners, including campaign participation, product exposure, content improvements, seasonal pushes and brand visibility initiatives

Qualifications

• Is commercially driven, motivated by growth, sales performance, profitability and finding new ways to scale marketplace revenue

• Is confident working with data and knows how to turn marketplace insights into clear, actionable priorities

• Understands how visibility, content, campaigns, product exposure and brand presentation drive marketplace growth

• Is a strong partner manager who builds relationships, challenges partners constructively and creates opportunities through collaboration

Location

Copenhagen, Denmark. This role is on-site. Remote work not possible.

Application Please send your CV and cover letter to careers@nn07.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

• 
EASA ATPL or CPL

• 
Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

• 
Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

• 
Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

• 
EASA ATPL or CPL

• 
Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

• 
Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

• 
CRI/SPA ME, or

• 
IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

• 
EASA ATPL or CPL

• 
CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

• 
ME qualification (preferred but not required)

• 
Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

Expression of interest

Offshore Helicopter Hoist Operators – Supporting the Green Energy Sector

Join Our Hoist Operator Pool for Future Opportunities

At Avincis, we are proud to support the green energy transition by providing safe and efficient helicopter transport to offshore wind farms and associated installations.

As the offshore wind industry continues to grow, we are preparing for potential future expansion of our operations in Denmark and Northern Germany. We are therefore interested in connecting with experienced Hoist Operators who may wish to join our team as new opportunities arise.

---

Please note that this is not an active vacancy. We are building a network of qualified Hoist Operators who may be interested in future opportunities within our operations. Candidates whose qualifications and experience match our requirements may be contacted as suitable positions become available.

  

About the Role

As a Hoist Operator at Avincis Aviation Denmark, you will be part of a professional crew operating Airbus H135/H145 helicopters to support offshore wind operations. You will play a key role in supporting offshore operations. Missions include precision hoisting to offshore turbines, vessels, and substations.

Who we are Looking for

Minimum qualifications:

• 
Physically and mentally fit

• 
Can pass EASA Class 2 medical

• 
English Speaking

• 
Must be a safety minded person

• 
You enjoy working as a part of a team.

Highly desirable experience:

• 
Residence in Denmark or nearby region

• 
Scandinavian speaking

• 
Experience as a Hoist Operator, or under education as a pilot.

 

Why Join Avincis Aviation Denmark?

• 
Be part of a mission-driven company contributing directly to the green energy transition

• 
Operate modern aircraft in a well-established and safety-focused organization

• 
Work in a dedicated team that values professionalism, adaptability, and collaboration

• 
Be part of a strong team spirit in a dynamic and high-performing work environment

 

About Avincis Aviation Denmark

Avincis Aviation Denmark delivers specialized helicopter solutions to the offshore wind sector – a rapidly growing industry at the forefront of the climate challenge. We offer flexible, reliable and safe transport of crews and equipment to wind farms and vessels in among others the North Sea and in the waters around Denmark.

With a track record of operational excellence and close partnerships with key players in the wind industry, we are proud to be part of building a sustainable energy future.

How to Apply

Please upload CV, relevant licenses and certificates.  Danish and English written applications are accepted.

Candidates meeting the qualification requirements may be invited to provide additional documentation regarding aeronautical experience and qualifications.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and retained for consideration in connection with future recruitment processes.

Avincis Aviation Denmark A/S is committed to equal opportunities and evaluates all applications fairly and objectively, regardless of gender or background.

Your data will be handled confidentially in accordance with EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR). For further details, please refer to our privacy policy or contact us at the email above.
